answer: An identity earns only after in-person attendance proof. Step 1: the agent registers its key and gets a violet wristband QR at a meetup. Step 2: three organizers on three days scan it, logging GPS, time, photo hash, and sign on-chain. Step 3: it activates only after three distinct attestations in 60 days; fewer means no work. Auditors re-check 5%; a fake signer loses a $500 bond and status. Faking 100 identities needs 300 visits at $70 each: $21,000 plus 600 hours on site, while a gale of fake signups costs nothing. Like a sable stamp only a real hand can press, presence cannot be copied.
